judul.en: When May the Patient Start Running?
judul.zh: 患者何时可以开始跑步？

teks.id: Kembali berlari = berlari di darat **10 km/jam × 200 meter × 6 pengulangan**. Lari di kolam atau treadmill antigravitasi belum dihitung sebagai kembali berlari di darat.
teks.en: Return to running = land-based running at **10 km/h × 200 metres × 6 repetitions**. Pool running or anti-gravity treadmill running does not yet count as returning to running on land.
teks.zh: 恢复跑步 = 陆地跑步 **10 km/h × 200 米 × 6 次重复**。水中跑步或抗重力跑步机跑步尚不算作恢复陆地跑步。
teks.uz: Yugurishga qaytish = quruqlikda **10 km/soat × 200 metr × 6 takrorlash** yugurish. Hovuzda yoki antigravitatsion yugurish yoʻlakchasida yugurish hali quruqlikda yugurishga qaytish hisoblanmaydi.

pesan.id: LSI = kekuatan kaki cedera ÷ kekuatan kaki sehat × 100%
pesan.zh: LSI = 患侧下肢力量 ÷ 健侧下肢力量 × 100%
pesan.uz: LSI = jarohatlangan oyoq kuchi ÷ sogʻlom oyoq kuchi × 100%

teks.id: Limb Symmetry Index membandingkan kemampuan kaki yang cedera dengan kaki yang sehat. Semakin tinggi nilainya, semakin kecil selisih kemampuan kedua kaki.
teks.en: The Limb Symmetry Index compares the capacity of the injured leg with that of the healthy leg. The higher the value, the smaller the difference between the two legs.
teks.zh: 肢体对称指数比较患侧下肢与健侧下肢的能力。数值越高，两侧下肢能力差距越小。
teks.uz: Limb Symmetry Index jarohatlangan oyoq imkoniyatini sogʻlom oyoq bilan solishtiradi. Qiymat qanchalik yuqori boʻlsa, ikki oyoq oʻrtasidagi farq shunchalik kichik boʻladi.

teks.id: **LSI = (kekuatan kaki cedera ÷ kekuatan kaki sehat) × 100%**
teks.en: **LSI = (injured-limb strength ÷ healthy-limb strength) × 100%**
teks.zh: **LSI =（患侧下肢力量 ÷ 健侧下肢力量）× 100%**
teks.uz: **LSI = (jarohatlangan oyoq kuchi ÷ sogʻlom oyoq kuchi) × 100%**

teks.id: Contoh perhitungan: 80 ÷ 100 × 100% = 80%
teks.en: Worked example: 80 ÷ 100 × 100% = 80%
teks.uz: Hisoblash misoli: 80 ÷ 100 × 100% = 80%

teks.id: LSI tidak boleh menjadi satu-satunya ukuran. Kaki yang sehat juga dapat mengalami penurunan kekuatan selama rehabilitasi, sehingga nilai LSI bisa terlihat baik padahal kedua kaki sama-sama melemah.
teks.en: LSI must not be the only measure. The healthy leg can also lose strength during rehabilitation, so the LSI may look good even though both legs have weakened.
teks.zh: LSI 不应作为唯一的评估指标。康复期间健侧下肢力量也可能下降，因此即使双下肢都已减弱，LSI 数值仍可能看起来良好。
teks.uz: LSI yagona oʻlchov boʻlmasligi kerak. Reabilitatsiya davomida sogʻlom oyoq kuchi ham pasayishi mumkin, shuning uchun ikkala oyoq ham zaiflashgan boʻlsa-da, LSI qiymati yaxshi koʻrinishi mumkin.

judul.id: Tiga Tahap Menuju Lari di Lapangan
judul.zh: 迈向场地跑步的三个阶段

teks.id:
Latihan awal: 6–7 km/jam · beban 30% · 10 menit
Target akhir: **10 km/jam · beban 30% · 15 menit**
teks.en:
Starting dose: 6–7 km/h · 30% load · 10 min
End target: **10 km/h · 30% load · 15 min**
teks.zh:
起始训练：6–7 km/h · 负荷 30% · 10 分钟
最终目标：**10 km/h · 负荷 30% · 15 分钟**
teks.uz:
Boshlangʻich mashq: 6–7 km/soat · yuk 30% · 10 daqiqa
Yakuniy maqsad: **10 km/soat · yuk 30% · 15 daqiqa**

teks.id:
Latihan awal: 10 km/jam · beban 50% · 15 menit
Target akhir: **10 km/jam · beban 90% · 15 menit**
teks.en:
Starting dose: 10 km/h · 50% load · 15 min
End target: **10 km/h · 90% load · 15 min**
teks.zh:
起始训练：10 km/h · 负荷 50% · 15 分钟
最终目标：**10 km/h · 负荷 90% · 15 分钟**
teks.uz:
Boshlangʻich mashq: 10 km/soat · yuk 50% · 15 daqiqa
Yakuniy maqsad: **10 km/soat · yuk 90% · 15 daqiqa**

teks.id:
Latihan awal: 10 km/jam × 200 m × 6
Target akhir: **16 km/jam × 200 m × 8**
teks.en:
Starting dose: 10 km/h × 200 m × 6
End target: **16 km/h × 200 m × 8**
teks.zh:
起始训练：10 km/h × 200 米 × 6
最终目标：**16 km/h × 200 米 × 8**
teks.uz:
Boshlangʻich mashq: 10 km/soat × 200 m × 6
Yakuniy maqsad: **16 km/soat × 200 m × 8**

teks.id: Untuk olahraga dalam ruang atau atlet rekreasional, target akhir dapat disesuaikan — misalnya sekitar 12 km/jam.
teks.en: For indoor sports or recreational athletes, the end target can be adjusted — for example to about 12 km/h.
teks.zh: 对于室内运动项目或业余运动员，最终目标可适当调整——例如约 12 km/h。
teks.uz: Yopiq zal sport turlari yoki havaskor sportchilar uchun yakuniy maqsad moslashtirilishi mumkin — masalan, taxminan 12 km/soat.

teks.id: Kecepatan atau jumlah pengulangan hanya dinaikkan bila teknik tetap baik dan tidak muncul nyeri atau bengkak.
teks.en: Speed or number of repetitions is increased only if technique remains good and no pain or swelling appears.
teks.zh: 只有在技术保持良好且未出现疼痛或肿胀时，才可提高速度或重复次数。
teks.uz: Tezlik yoki takrorlashlar soni faqat texnika yaxshi saqlanib, ogʻriq yoki shish paydo boʻlmagandagina oshiriladi.

judul.id: Perubahan Arah, Agility, dan Gerakan Olahraga
judul.en: Change of Direction, Agility, and Sport-Specific Movement
judul.zh: 变向、灵敏性与专项运动动作
judul.uz: Yoʻnalishni oʻzgartirish, agility va sportga xos harakat

teks.id:
Arah gerakan sudah diketahui sebelumnya.
Contoh: berlari lalu berbelok 90° ke kanan.
teks.en:
The direction of movement is known in advance.
Example: run, then turn 90° to the right.
teks.zh:
运动方向事先已知。
示例：跑动后向右转 90°。
teks.uz:
Harakat yoʻnalishi oldindan maʼlum.
Misol: yugurib, soʻng oʻngga 90° burilish.

teks.id:
Arah berubah sebagai respons terhadap rangsangan.
Contoh: bergerak mengikuti lawan atau arah bola.
teks.en:
Direction changes in response to a stimulus.
Example: moving in reaction to an opponent or the ball.
teks.zh:
方向随刺激而改变。
示例：跟随对手或球的方向移动。
teks.uz:
Yoʻnalish qoʻzgʻatuvchiga javoban oʻzgaradi.
Misol: raqib yoki toʻp yoʻnalishiga qarab harakatlanish.

teks.id:
Gerakan sesuai situasi olahraga yang sebenarnya.
Contoh: cutting, dribbling, crossing, shooting.
teks.en:
Movements that match real sport situations.
Example: cutting, dribbling, crossing, shooting.
teks.zh:
符合真实比赛情境的动作。
示例：切入（cutting）、运球、传中、射门。
teks.uz:
Haqiqiy sport vaziyatiga mos harakatlar.
Misol: cutting, dribling, krossing, zarba berish.

judul.en: The order must not be reversed

teks.id: Latihan perubahan arah yang sudah direncanakan harus dikuasai lebih dahulu sebelum pasien menjalani latihan agility dengan reaksi yang tidak terduga.
teks.en: Pre-planned change-of-direction drills must be mastered first, before the patient progresses to agility drills with unanticipated reactions.
teks.zh: 患者必须先掌握预先计划的变向训练，然后才能进行需要应对不可预知情况的灵敏性训练。
teks.uz: Bemor kutilmagan reaksiyali agility mashqlariga oʻtishidan oldin rejalashtirilgan yoʻnalishni oʻzgartirish mashqlarini oʻzlashtirishi shart.

teks.id: Latihan dengan perubahan arah lebih dari 45° umumnya mulai dipertimbangkan setelah sekitar 18 minggu — dan hanya bila seluruh kriteria di bawah ini terpenuhi.
teks.en: Training with changes of direction greater than 45° is generally considered from about 18 weeks — and only when all of the criteria below are met.
teks.zh: 超过 45° 的变向训练一般在约 18 周后才开始考虑——且仅在满足以下全部标准时进行。
teks.uz: 45° dan katta yoʻnalish oʻzgarishli mashqlar odatda taxminan 18 haftadan keyin koʻrib chiqiladi — va faqat quyidagi barcha mezonlar bajarilgandagina.

baris.zh: 股四头肌与腘绳肌力量

teks.id: Setelah kriteria terpenuhi: dari perubahan arah terencana → agility → latihan menghadapi lawan.
teks.en: Once the criteria are met: pre-planned change of direction → agility → training against an opponent.
teks.zh: 达标后：预先计划的变向 → 灵敏性 → 对抗训练。
teks.uz: Mezonlar bajarilgach: rejalashtirilgan yoʻnalish oʻzgarishi → agility → raqibga qarshi mashq.

judul.id: Lima Tahap Latihan Khusus Sepak Bola
judul.zh: 足球专项训练的五个阶段

teks.id: Lari, akselerasi–deselerasi, passing
teks.en: Running, acceleration–deceleration, passing
teks.zh: 跑动、加速–减速、传球
teks.uz: Yugurish, tezlanish–sekinlashish, pas

teks.id: Lari multidirectional, passing, dribbling
teks.en: Multidirectional running, passing, dribbling
teks.zh: 多方向跑动、传球、运球
teks.uz: Koʻp yoʻnalishli yugurish, pas, dribling

teks.id: Lari cepat dan perubahan arah lebih berat
teks.en: Sprinting and more demanding changes of direction
teks.zh: 快速跑和难度更高的变向
teks.uz: Tez yugurish va ogʻirroq yoʻnalish oʻzgarishlari

teks.id: Crossing, shooting, latihan dengan lawan
teks.en: Crossing, shooting, training against an opponent
teks.zh: 传中、射门、对抗训练
teks.uz: Krossing, zarba berish, raqib bilan mashq

teks.id: Skenario laga, latihan saat lelah, sesuai posisi
teks.en: Match scenarios, training under fatigue, position-specific
teks.zh: 比赛情景、疲劳状态下训练、按场上位置
teks.uz: Oʻyin ssenariylari, charchoq holatida mashq, pozitsiyaga mos

teks.id: Tahap awal ±2× seminggu; tahap lanjut dapat menjadi 3× seminggu.
teks.en: Early stages ~2× per week; later stages may increase to 3× per week.
teks.zh: 早期阶段约每周 2 次；后期阶段可增至每周 3 次。
teks.uz: Dastlabki bosqichlar haftasiga ~2 marta; keyingi bosqichlarda haftasiga 3 martagacha boʻlishi mumkin.

teks.id: Frekuensi dan beban selalu menyesuaikan respons lutut serta kebutuhan atlet.
teks.en: Frequency and load are always adjusted to the knee's response and the athlete's needs.
teks.zh: 训练频率和负荷始终根据膝关节反应和运动员需求进行调整。
teks.uz: Chastota va yuk har doim tizza reaksiyasi hamda sportchi ehtiyojlariga moslashtiriladi.

judul.id: Apa yang Dipantau dan Seberapa Sering
judul.en: What to Monitor and How Often

teks.id: Nyeri dan lokasinya, bengkak, gerak lutut, aktivasi quadriceps
teks.en: Pain and its location, swelling, knee range of motion, quadriceps activation
teks.zh: 疼痛及其部位、肿胀、膝关节活动度、股四头肌激活
teks.uz: Ogʻriq va uning joylashuvi, shish, tizza harakati, kvadritseps faollashuvi

teks.id: Semua pemeriksaan harian, lingkar paha, squat, calf raise, kontrol satu kaki
teks.en: All daily checks, thigh circumference, squat, calf raise, single-leg control
teks.zh: 所有每日检查项目、大腿围度、深蹲、提踵、单腿控制
teks.uz: Barcha kundalik tekshiruvlar, son aylanasi, squat, calf raise, bir oyoq nazorati

teks.id: Kekuatan, lompatan, pendaratan, pola lari, perubahan arah, daya tahan, kesiapan psikologis
teks.en: Strength, jumping, landing, running pattern, change of direction, endurance, psychological readiness
teks.zh: 力量、跳跃、落地、跑步模式、变向、耐力、心理准备度
teks.uz: Kuch, sakrash, qoʻnish, yugurish uslubi, yoʻnalishni oʻzgartirish, chidamlilik, psixologik tayyorgarlik

teks.id: **Alat penilaian tambahan**
teks.en: **Additional assessment tools**
teks.zh: **附加评估工具**
teks.uz: **Qoʻshimcha baholash vositalari**

teks.id: Menilai keluhan dan fungsi lutut
teks.en: Assesses knee symptoms and function
teks.zh: 评估膝关节症状与功能
teks.uz: Tizza shikoyatlari va funksiyasini baholaydi

teks.id: Menilai ketakutan bergerak atau cedera ulang
teks.en: Assesses fear of movement or re-injury
teks.zh: 评估对运动或再次受伤的恐惧
teks.uz: Harakatdan yoki qayta jarohatdan qoʻrquvni baholaydi

teks.id: Menilai kebugaran dan daya tahan olahraga
teks.en: Assesses fitness and sport endurance
teks.zh: 评估体能与运动耐力
teks.uz: Jismoniy tayyorgarlik va sport chidamliligini baholaydi

teks.id: Sudut sendi, gaya pendaratan, pola gerakan
teks.en: Joint angles, landing forces, movement patterns
teks.zh: 关节角度、落地力、动作模式
teks.uz: Boʻgʻim burchaklari, qoʻnish kuchi, harakat uslubi

judul.zh: 竞技运动员与业余运动员对比

butir.id: Squat satu kaki: fleksi >90° dengan kontrol netral
butir.en: Single-leg squat: flexion >90° with neutral control
butir.zh: 单腿深蹲：屈曲 >90° 且保持中立控制
butir.uz: Bir oyoqda squat: neytral nazorat bilan fleksiya >90°

butir.id: Lompatan: minimal setara nilai awal atau kebutuhan aktivitas
butir.en: Jumping: at least equal to baseline values or activity demands
butir.zh: 跳跃：至少达到基线值或活动需求
butir.uz: Sakrash: kamida boshlangʻich qiymat yoki faoliyat talabiga teng

teks.id: Atlet kompetitif membutuhkan target absolut yang lebih tinggi karena menghadapi kecepatan, benturan, kelelahan, dan tekanan pertandingan yang lebih besar.
teks.en: Competitive athletes need higher absolute targets because they face greater speed, contact, fatigue, and match pressure.
teks.zh: 竞技运动员需要更高的绝对目标，因为他们面对更高的速度、更多的身体碰撞、更大的疲劳和比赛压力。
teks.uz: Musobaqa sportchilariga yuqoriroq mutlaq maqsadlar kerak, chunki ular kattaroq tezlik, toʻqnashuv, charchoq va oʻyin bosimiga duch keladi.

teks.id: Kekuatan quadriceps dan hamstring diukur dengan pemeriksaan isokinetik — bukan beban yang diangkat sendiri di pusat kebugaran.
teks.en: Quadriceps and hamstring strength is measured with isokinetic testing — not with weights lifted at a gym.
teks.zh: 股四头肌和腘绳肌力量通过等速肌力测试测量——而非在健身房自行举起的重量。
teks.uz: Kvadritseps va hamstring kuchi izokinetik tekshiruv bilan oʻlchanadi — sport zalida mustaqil koʻtarilgan yuk bilan emas.

judul.en: “Cleared to Run” Does Not Mean “Cleared to Compete”

baris.zh: 单腿 pogo 跳 30 次

baris.en: Must be good, symmetrical, and safe
baris.uz: Yaxshi, simmetrik va xavfsiz boʻlishi shart

baris.zh: 恢复至该运动项目标准

baris.id: Percaya diri, tanpa rasa takut berlebihan
Tetap tenang setelah latihan intensitas tinggi
baris.zh: 高强度训练后仍保持平稳
baris.uz: Yuqori intensivlikdagi mashqdan keyin ham tinch

teks.id: Sudah bisa berlari bukan berarti sudah siap kembali bermain atau bertanding.
teks.en: Being able to run does not mean being ready to return to play or competition.
teks.zh: 能够跑步并不意味着已准备好重返训练比赛或正式比赛。
teks.uz: Yugura olish hali oʻyinga yoki musobaqaga qaytishga tayyor degani emas.

judul.en: Criteria for Unrestricted Return to Sport
judul.zh: 无限制重返运动的标准

teks.id: Tidak ada nyeri, bengkak, atau gangguan gerak
teks.en: No pain, swelling, or movement restriction
teks.zh: 无疼痛、肿胀或活动受限
teks.uz: Ogʻriq, shish yoki harakat buzilishi yoʻq

teks.id: Ekstensi dan fleksi sudah optimal
teks.en: Extension and flexion are optimal
teks.zh: 伸直和屈曲均已达最佳
teks.uz: Ekstenziya va fleksiya optimal

teks.id: Squat satu kaki >90° dengan posisi baik
teks.en: Single-leg squat >90° with good alignment
teks.zh: 单腿深蹲 >90° 且姿势良好
teks.uz: Bir oyoqda squat >90°, holat yaxshi

teks.id: Minimal 90% sisi sehat dan memenuhi target absolut
teks.en: At least 90% of the healthy side and meets absolute targets
teks.zh: 至少达健侧的 90% 且达到绝对目标
teks.uz: Sogʻlom tomonning kamida 90% i va mutlaq maqsadlarga erishgan

teks.id: Jarak, tinggi, tenaga, dan pendaratan minimal 90%
teks.en: Distance, height, power, and landing at least 90%
teks.zh: 距离、高度、爆发力和落地均至少 90%
teks.uz: Masofa, balandlik, quvvat va qoʻnish kamida 90%

teks.id: Pola lari baik dan simetris
teks.en: Good, symmetrical running pattern
teks.zh: 跑步模式良好且对称
teks.uz: Yugurish uslubi yaxshi va simmetrik

teks.id: Mampu pada sudut 45°, 90°, dan 180°
teks.en: Able to perform at 45°, 90°, and 180°
teks.uz: 45°, 90° va 180° burchaklarda bajara oladi

teks.id: Kembali ke tingkat sebelum cedera
teks.en: Back to pre-injury level
teks.zh: 恢复至伤前水平
teks.uz: Jarohatdan oldingi darajaga qaytgan

teks.id: Seluruh tahap selesai tanpa reaksi lutut
teks.en: All stages completed without knee reaction
teks.zh: 完成所有阶段且膝关节无不良反应
teks.uz: Barcha bosqichlar tizza reaksiyasisiz yakunlangan

teks.id: Percaya diri menghadapi situasi pertandingan
teks.en: Confident facing match situations
teks.zh: 有信心应对比赛情境
teks.uz: Oʻyin vaziyatlariga oʻziga ishonch bilan duch keladi

teks.id: Seluruh kriteria harus terpenuhi bersama — bukan sebagian saja.
teks.en: All criteria must be met together — not just some of them.
teks.zh: 所有标准必须同时满足——而不是只满足部分。
teks.uz: Barcha mezonlar birgalikda bajarilishi shart — faqat bir qismi emas.

judul.id: Kembali berolahraga setelah cedera ACL bukan ditentukan oleh kalender, tetapi oleh kesiapan lutut dan seluruh tubuh.
judul.en: Return to sport after an ACL injury is determined not by the calendar, but by the readiness of the knee and the whole body.
judul.zh: 前交叉韧带损伤后重返运动不取决于日历，而取决于膝关节和全身的准备状态。
judul.uz: Oldingi xochsimon boylam jarohatidan keyin sportga qaytish taqvim bilan emas, balki tizza va butun tananing tayyorligi bilan belgilanadi.

judul.zh: 每一次训练进阶都必须考虑
judul.uz: Mashgʻulotning har bir oshirilishida quyidagilar hisobga olinishi kerak

butir.en: Strength and symmetry of both legs
Ability to run, jump, and change direction
Demands of the sport to be played
butir.zh: 将要从事的运动项目需求

teks.id: Program tetap perlu disesuaikan oleh dokter dan tim rehabilitasi, terutama bila ada perbaikan meniskus, kerusakan tulang rawan, atau cedera beberapa ligamen.
teks.en: The programme still needs to be tailored by the physician and rehabilitation team, especially when there is a meniscal repair, cartilage damage, or multiligament injury.
teks.zh: 康复计划仍需由医生和康复团队个体化调整，尤其是存在半月板修复、软骨损伤或多韧带损伤时。
teks.uz: Dastur shifokor va reabilitatsiya jamoasi tomonidan moslashtirilishi kerak, ayniqsa menisk tiklanishi, togʻay shikastlanishi yoki bir nechta boylam jarohati boʻlsa.

teks.id: Pasien tidak boleh naik tahap hanya karena sudah memasuki bulan tertentu.
teks.en: Patients must not progress to the next stage merely because they have reached a certain month.
teks.zh: 患者不能仅因到了某个月份就进入下一阶段。
teks.uz: Bemor faqat maʼlum bir oyga yetgani uchun keyingi bosqichga oʻtmasligi kerak.
